ord.description: the order of vector norm. Default: 2. See :func:`torch.linalg.vector_norm` for a list of supported norms.

dim.description: the dimension along which normalize is computed.

eps.description: small value to avoid division by zero. Default: 1e-12. dtype (:class:`torch.dtype`, optional): the desired data type of returned tensor. If specified, the input tensor is casted to :attr:`dtype` before the operation is performed. Default: None.

mask.description: the boolean tensor containing the binary mask of validity of input tensor elements. Default: None that is equivalent to ``torch.ones(input.shape, dtype=torch.bool)``.
